- Metadata lives in `data/db.json` (blobs on disk); Postgres wiring is the next step.
- Admin "contact member" leaves an in-app to-do; email needs SMTP credentials in Settings.
- Unused-dependency detection covers npm/PyPI; other ecosystems rely on OSV only.
- "Apply fix" is copy-paste by design — review every fix before pushing again.
- Single-node only; no clustering or object storage yet.
